values.goal: Coordinate the five bounded WP-10A child issues into one live distributed workcell proof without acquiring product or autonomous lifecycle authority.
values.required_outcome: The conductor, task adapter, dashboard, convergence loop, and live proof complete in declared order with disjoint claims and truthful integration evidence.
declared_scope: child dependency ordering and interface freezes
authority_boundary: child issues own all product paths
typed C-SDLC v2 claims remain ownership authority
live merge plus ancestry releases downstream execution
closeout receipts are non-blocking audit evidence
no autonomous task creation, GitHub mutation, merge, or closeout
operator_constraints: one bounded review immediately before each child PR
do not make receipts an execution gate
